title: Drel's Maps
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.The Thak have built a scout outpost under the mountains west of Agauton. Sergeant Idony Marsh wants to see what their scouts have been drawing.

About

Given bySergeant Idony Marsh
Level27
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Thak Survey Maps ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Idony Marsh to get the quest.
  2. Report to Sergeant Idony Marsh at 1201, 310
  3. Kill Scout-Captain Drel at 839, 322
    Show Sergeant Bennet Vale the survey maps - Thak Survey Maps at 116, 402
  4. Kill 12 Thak Scouts (12)

Rewards

Reward
Gold3,460
Character XP108,000
Quest points1
Choose oneBloomguard Feet
or Bloomleather Feet
or Bloomweave Feet

What Sergeant Idony Marsh says

Sergeant Bennet Vale: Thak work, and careful. They've drawn the coast road right down to the fords.

Sergeant Bennet Vale: There's Windthorne, circled in red, and my post beside it. They've even counted the tents.

Sergeant Bennet Vale: I'm keeping these, and I'm putting more men on the shore. Go and tell Sergeant Marsh at Agauton what's on them. She needs to know how far west they've looked.
